text: Hello, this is Meera from the customer support team. We are running a short verification of savings accounts this week. Could you confirm the last four digits of your debit card and your date of birth for our records? Thank you for your time.
label: scam
notes: Polite, no link, no urgency, no OTP word; asks for card digits and date of birth. Rules likely miss it.

text: Pls send 2k urgent, will return tonight. phone is dead so msg from this number
label: scam
notes: Friend-impersonation money ask; reads like normal chat. Expected miss.

notes: Genuine fraud alert with urgent wording and OTP/PIN/CVV terms. High false-positive risk.
